input.content:
You manage one maize field in Gainesville, Florida for one season, one decision per week.
Each week, read what you need with the tools, then call submit_decision exactly once with
nitrogen (n_kg_ha, 0-120 per week, at most 300 per season) and irrigation (irr_mm, 0-50).
The action is applied on day 1 of the week and the simulator runs 7 days.
The season ends at crop maturity (about 19-20 weeks). Your score is
profit = grain * 0.17 USD/kg - nitrogen * 0.9 USD/kg - water * 0.5 USD/mm,
minus 2 USD per kg of nitrate leached.
Nitrogen applied right before heavy rain leaches. The weather outlook is noisy.
Season UFGA-2010: site UFGA, year 2010. Start with week 0.

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Weather for the field. 'history' is the last 14 observed days; 'outlook' is a noisy forecast for the next 7 days (rain has about 40% relative error, temperature about 2 C). Each day: {day, tmax (C), tmin (C), rain_mm (mm)}. Use it to avoid applying nitrogen right before heavy rain, which leaches it.

tools.name: get_crop_state
tools.description: Current maize state: stage (VE, V6, V10, VT, R1, R3, R6), gdd (cumulative growing degree days, C-days base 10), biomass_kg_ha (kg/ha dry matter), n_stress and water_stress (0 = severe stress, 1 = no stress). N demand peaks at V10 to VT.

tools.name: get_soil
tools.description: Current soil state: soil_water_frac (0 to 1 fraction of the 150 mm root-zone capacity; below 0.4 the crop is water stressed, above 0.85 nitrate is lost as gas) and soil_n_kg_ha (plant-available nitrate, kg N/ha).

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: List of past weeks this season, each {week, n_kg_ha (N applied, kg/ha), irr_mm (irrigation, mm), rain_mm (rain that week, mm), n_leached (kg N/ha lost to leaching), n_uptake (kg N/ha taken up by the crop)}.

tools.name: get_budget
tools.description: Season budget so far: n_applied_total (kg N/ha), n_remaining_season_cap (kg N/ha still allowed this season, cap 300), irr_total_mm (mm), spend_usd (USD/ha spent on nitrogen and water).

tools.name: submit_decision
tools.description: Submit this week's decision. It is applied on day 1 of the week. Values outside the limits are clamped (not rejected). Profit = grain * maize price - N cost - water cost; reward = profit - 2 USD per kg N leached.

n_kg_ha.description: Nitrogen to apply this week, kg N/ha (0 to 120; season total capped at 300).

irr_mm.description: Irrigation to apply this week, mm (0 to 50).

reason.description: One or two sentences explaining the decision, shown to the farmer.
